title: Merge and Archers — a browser merge-and-defense
author: sspark2738
selftext:
Hi, I’m the developer of Merge and Archers. I recently put a playable browser version on [itch.io](http://itch.io) and wanted to share it here.

You summon archers, drag matching ones together to merge them, and your squad automatically fights incoming monsters. Defeat 20 monsters to unlock a boss challenge.

The game is currently in English. If you try it, I’d find it useful to know whether the merging is easy to understand and how the difficulty feels as you progress. Bug reports are welcome too.

Play in your browser: [\[itch.io link\]](https://sspark2738.itch.io/merge-and-archer)
